section.p: For an order without approved credit terms, Finance issues an invoice, waits for the received deposit, then records financial clearance. Orders with approved terms take the separate clearance route.

blockquote.p: For a new client without approved credit terms, the Finance branch begins by issuing the deposit invoice, waits for the deposit to arrive, records financial clearance, and ends with finance cleared.

blockquote.button: Round 1: normal flow and parallel work

blockquote.class: rounded-md border-l-2 border-primary/30 bg-muted/50 p-3 text-sm leading-relaxed
blockquote.p: At entry to the Finance branch, check whether this service order already has credit terms approved by Finance. If approved credit terms exist, record financial clearance without issuing or waiting for a deposit invoice. Otherwise issue the deposit invoice, wait for the deposit to arrive, then record financial clearance. Being a repeat client is not sufficient by itself; a repeat client without approved credit terms follows the deposit path.
